statement: Produce the evidence-backed immutable Vibez candidate that Fantasy Football can safely adopt.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: Supported JS/types/CLI/assets and complete current workflow pass from a clean installed artifact without source checkout access.
AC-02: At least two independent project roots are isolated; a non-npm consumer uses only configured validators.
AC-03: Happy path, role/revision/CI rejection, failed review/rework, duplicate attempts, restart and uncertain merge outcomes preserve current guarantees.
AC-04: Source-delta reconciliation is complete and the artifact maps to a reviewed destination SHA and checksum.
AC-05: The release candidate is downloadable/installable through the agreed channel; fresh maintainer install/configure/diagnose/rollback instructions are exercised.
AC-06: Fixtures, live feature evidence and untested limitations are clearly distinguished in the acceptance report.
